$comment: Design tokens for apps/manual (manual.buildanagent.fyi). The single source of the book's colours, fonts and sizes: apps/manual/scripts/generate-tokens.ts writes src/styles/tokens.css from this file, and the app's tests fail when that CSS is stale or a pair below misses its ratio. Decided by the owner on 2026-11-19 (book plan BK12); T2 proposed the dark panel border, the non-text pairs, the font files, the phone sizes and the layout widths, and the owner accepted them on 2026-11-19. Contrast ratios are WCAG 2.x, computed from the hex values and rounded to two decimals.

light.$comment: C4 Clay and Cream, light page

dark.$comment: C4's brown page, dark mode. link is #F2C2A4 (owner, 2026-11-19), a paler shade than the accent so links and accent labels differ; links keep an underline because neither link colour reaches 3:1 against body text.

panelLight.$comment: Code and figure panels in light mode (owner, 2026-11-19): one shade darker than the page, framed by the light rule as a border, with deeper syntax colours. comment also serves labels and line numbers; amber is keywords, olive strings, terracotta highlights.

panelDark.$comment: Code and figure panels in dark mode: C1 Ember (owner, 2026-11-19). border is the dark rule, as the light panel uses the light rule (proposed by T2 and accepted by the owner on 2026-11-19).

nonText.$comment: Focus rings, control borders and figure lines that carry meaning need 3:1 against what they sit on (WCAG 1.4.11). The focus ring is the accent, so it is measured on the page and on the panel of each mode (proposed by T2 and accepted by the owner on 2026-11-19).

decorativeOnly.$comment: These colours fail both 4.5:1 and 3:1, so use them only for dividers, panel borders and grid lines, never for text, focus rings or figure lines that carry meaning. Each colour is named as <set>.<key> and measured on the background it sits on.

font.$comment: Each family is served from the book itself: files are paths under apps/manual/public, written by apps/manual/scripts/subset-fonts.py (the file entries proposed by T2 and accepted by the owner on 2026-11-19)

code.$comment: Served as subsets derived from Google Sans Code, under the neutral family name Manual Code, because its TRADEMARKS.md keeps the Google mark off modified versions

size.$comment: px. The desktop values come from the reference page at 1280 px wide; the phone values apply at 360 px (proposed by T2 and accepted by the owner on 2026-11-19). The generated CSS converts both to rem and scales between them with the viewport width

layout.$comment: px, proposed by T2 and accepted by the owner on 2026-11-19, for direction C's layout: the widest content (header, title, figure panel), the prose measure, the side-note column beside the prose and the side gutter, which scales like the sizes. The owner asked the same day for less empty space right of the text on desktops, so the page widened from 1152 and the measure from 608; listings, figures, tables and tabs take the whole article column, wider than the measure. With the owner's 'TOC on the right' (2026-11-19) a chapter's article column stops at articleMax, the measure, a gap and a side note, so the prose ends near the rail; the chapter page is then only as wide as the sidebar, the article, the rail and their gaps, centred

source: The owner's design canvas, board 'Reference design' (private).
